products.title: Reversible Polartec® Fleece Vest
products.body_html: Made from Polartec® 100, the original synthetic fleece that set the industry standard. Lightweight, breathable and incredibly durable, it keeps you warm without weighing you down. One side is water repellent woven fabric, the other cosy fleece, offering versatile style and practical warmth and the ideal layering piece for transitional weather. Contrast woven fabric on the shoulders of the fleece side adds durability for your bag, and fleece lined welt pockets add comfort and secure storage.

products.title: Crewneck Polartec® Fleece
products.body_html: Made from Polartec® 100, the original synthetic fleece that set the industry standard. Lightweight, breathable, and incredibly durable, it keeps you warm without weighing you down. Cosy style for on and off course, with vintage inspired ribbing on the collar and underarm panels.

products.title: Argyle Pertex® Gilet
products.body_html: This is Pertex Quantum fabric: light, durable, water repellent, windproof, and warmer than any golf gilet you’ve ever worn. The outer is NETPLUS® by Pertex, made entirely from post consumer recycled fishing net. Inside is Primaloft Black Insulated ThermoPlume®, also fully post consumer recycled, which behaves like goose down for warmth, softness and packability. The diamond quilting is a nod to argyle, a pattern golf has been using for centuries. Double chest pockets take their shape from the course, the side pockets are concealed for storage and for cold hands, and the two way zip lets you move.

products.title: Argyle Pertex® Jacket
products.body_html: This is Pertex Quantum fabric: light, durable, water repellent, windproof, and warmer than any golf jacket you’ve ever comfortably swung in. The outer is NETPLUS® by Pertex, made entirely from post consumer recycled fishing net. Inside is Primaloft Black Insulated ThermoPlume®, also fully post consumer recycled, which behaves like goose down for warmth, softness and packability. The diamond quilting is a nod to argyle, a pattern golf has been using for centuries. Double chest pockets take their shape from the course, the side pockets are concealed for storage and for cold hands, and the two way zip lets you move.

products.title: The Honourable Company T-Shirt
The Honourable Company Sticker Pack
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Graphic Sticker pack is a selection of tags to show your pride for The United Kingdom of Golf.

products.title: A Game To Be Explored Ball Marker
Ripstop Tech Vest
products.body_html: Recycled ripstop from TORAY, two way stretch and water repellent. Ripstop built its reputation outdoors on durability alone, long before golf took an interest. The peaked hood has internal taped seams and a shock cord, so the weather stays where it belongs. The front pockets are laser cut in 3D, shapes taken from the course, and a bonded chest pocket holds a scorecard without creasing it. The two way zip opens from the bottom when you are walking. There is a matching trouser if you want to commit.

products.title: Heritage Primaloft® Cardigan
products.body_html: A classic golf style put back together in modern outdoor fabric. Primaloft Active Evolve has an open structure that holds warmth without adding bulk, which is why hike and run brands use it, and why you can still swing in it. The hand feel is close to wool, so it looks and feels vintage even though it has modern performance attributes. The full snap placket keeps the front clean with no loose fabric to catch mid swing. Zipped pockets and lightweight woven pocket bags for all your bits.

products.title: 1/4 Zip Primaloft® Mid-Layer
products.body_html: Ultramarathon runners have known about the primaloft fabric for years because of its lightweight warmth and flexibility. The Primaloft Quarter Zip Mid Layer is the first garment introducing the fabric for golfers who walk the course. We’ve added contrast panels across the shoulders to protect the fabric from your bag strap. The shoulders and sleeves are cut with a bend already in them, so the layer doesn't ride up at the top of the backswing. There are concealed pockets for your small items.

products.title: Ranger Mockneck Polo
products.body_html: MANORS signature curved style lines run through the Ranger Mockneck Polo and bold tonal mesh gussets sit under the arms where you need air. Made from soft Seawool® spun from used oyster shells and recycled plastic bottles, with UV 50+ protection, moisture management and odour control. The Mock Neck is back.

products.title: Ripstop Tech Trouser
products.body_html: Recycled TORAY ripstop, cut slim, with enough stretch in it to bend over a putt. Water and wind repellant. The waistband is elasticated for an athletic fit. The leg narrows slightly at the bottom so it breaks cleanly on the shoe instead of getting crumpled around it. There's an extra piece of fabric called a gusset built into the seat of the trousers so you can turn through the ball without the trouser pulling. The scorecard pockets are laser cut clean, no stitching or bulk, and shaped after bunkers.

products.title: Pine Course Polo
products.body_html: The pine print sits on our Course Polo, made from soft Seawool® spun from used oyster shells and recycled plastic bottles, with UV 50+ protection, moisture management and odour control. With curved side panelling, ribbed collar and three tonal buttons.

products.title: Flyer Course Polo
products.body_html: The print began with a bird's eye view of a course. It sits on our Course Polo, made from soft Seawool® spun from used oyster shells and recycled plastic bottles, with UV 50+ protection, moisture management and odour control. With curved side panelling, a ribbed collar and three tonal branded buttons for an understated finish.

products.title: Links Pique Polo
products.body_html: The print comes from the arc of the swing, one kinetic shape repeated until it reads as a traditional chain link motif. The fabric is a cotton blend performance pique with drirelease®, which uses synthetic and natural fibres together to push perspiration out through the face of the garment fast. Ribbed collar and sleeves, a traditional placket, embroidered chest and back branding.

products.title: Merino Tech Hoodie
products.body_html: The Merino Tech Hoodie is built from 100% natural merino wool, the game's original performance fabric. It keeps you warm when the wind bites, cool when the sun breaks through, and it won't hold odour even after a long day on the course. Unlike the scratchy wool jumpers of the past, this one is soft, machine-washable, and won't shrink or lose shape. A three piece hood and laser cut woven chest pocket, inspired by shapes on the course, are finished with ribbed cuffs and hem for comfort. Smart enough for the clubhouse, tough enough to live in your bag.

products.title: Reebok x Manors OG Pump Golf
products.body_html: A sporting legend reimagined for the fairways. First launched in 1989, Reebok’s revolutionary Pump technology changed sports by delivering a personalised fit with the push of a button. The OG Pump Golf brings that same innovation to the course. A full-grain pebbled leather upper and coated saddle combine for weatherproof comfort, while a spikeless outsole delivers grip across all terrains. With its classic brogue silhouette—this shoe is built for those who walk the course.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Club C Revenge Golf
products.body_html: The MANORS x Reebok II Club C Revenge Golf blends the clean aesthetic of Reebok's archive tennis shoes with features built for the green. First released in 1985, the Club C was born from tennis before it left the court for the streets. This version carries MANORS detailing throughout, from a debossed Eighteenth emblem to a branded window box with the GB flag, while a textured rubber golf outsole adds the traction you need for a stable swing.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Graphic Sticker Pack
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Graphic Sticker pack is a selection of tags to show your pride for The United Kingdom of Golf.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Ball Marker
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Ball Marker is a steel disc, 3.4cm across, finished with the United Kingdom of Golf artwork.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Harrington Jacket
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Harrington Jacket combines a timeless British style with the performance attributes of modern fabrics. The vintage texture comes with stretch and a water-repellent finish that moves with your swing. A proud United Kingdom of Golf embroidery runs across the centre back, while a mesh-lined body, elasticated cuffs and hem, and an adjustable cord and toggle keep it easy when the weather turns.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Shade Cap
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Shade Cap is a lightweight stretch cap with a little extra cover for the back of the neck, for the days the sun stays out. Built for breathability, with a moisture-wicking sweatband and a cord and toggle to dial in the fit.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Recycled Polo
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Recycled Polo fuses sustainability and style, taking cues from Reebok's 90s archives with bold curved panelling and vibrant mesh piping. It's cut from our signature soft Seawool® fabric, made from recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles, so it handles UV 50+ protection, moisture management and odour control on long Summer walks.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Towel
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Towel keeps your clubs, hands and golf balls clean through every hole. The print takes its cue from the vintage UK football shirts of the 90s. Soft, absorbent and durable, with a carabiner clip so it stays on the bag from the first tee to the last putt.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Graphic T-Shirt
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Graphic T-Shirt runs the same 240gsm cotton and relaxed fit as the Logo Tee, with the United Kingdom of Golf crest doing the talking. Soft, durable, and built for everyday.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Organic 1/4 Zip Pullover
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Organic 1/4 Zip Pullover pulls comfort, style and sustainability into one layer, with a nod to vintage sportswear. It's made from 100% GOTS-certified organic loopback cotton, with a raglan sleeve and contrast flatlock stitching that carries the throwback look. Bold chest embroidery, ribbed cuffs and hems, and a relaxed fit that layers easily on and off the green.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Logo T-Shirt
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Logo T-Shirt keeps it simple. Cut from 240gsm cotton with a relaxed fit, it's soft enough for everyday and heavy enough to last. Chest and back branding, and nothing you don't need.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Mock Neck Polo
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Mock Neck Polo takes its print from the vintage UK football shirts of the 90s and brings it onto the course. Mesh panelling under the arms keeps the air moving, while the high mock neck revives a silhouette worn on the game's biggest stages. It's made from soft Seawool® fabric, spun from recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles, with UV 50+ protection, moisture management and odour control. Relaxed fit, for the long way round.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Tech Cap
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Tech Cap borrows from running, cycling and other outdoor sports to bring a new essential garment to the fairways. A one size fits all cap made from technical fabrics so you've got one less thing to think about when shaping seven irons into wind at a tucked flag. The most stylish and functional golf hat we've ever made.

products.title: Reebok x Manors GOAT Pique Polo
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors GOAT Pique Polo blends performance with a vintage aesthetic. A cotton blend pique with drirelease® technology pushes perspiration to the surface to evaporate fast, while the anti-shrink fabric keeps a dry cotton hand feel. Yarn-dyed stripes, a ribbed collar and sleeves, a traditional placket and a relaxed fit carry timeless style with modern performance.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Tour Shirt
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Tour Shirt is a wind and water resistant short sleeve layer inspired by vintage wind proofs, ideal over a polo when conditions shift. At 148gsm, the lightweight 4-way stretch fabric pairs freedom of movement with protection from the elements. Curved panelling and raglan sleeves give a relaxed fit, while concealed pockets keep essentials safe when the temperature swings. The adjustable hem keeps your fit true.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Retro Crown Cap
products.body_html: The Reebok x Manors Retro Crown Cap is a six-panel snap back inspired by a baseball classic, with a short crown that sits low on the head, finished with a pre-curved brim that holds its shape round after round. One size fits all, adjustable at the back.

products.title: Reebok x Manors Club Pant
products.body_html: The MANORS x REEBOK II Club Pant is as at home in a posh pub as it is on the course. A 4-way stretch nylon spandex blend at 148gsm brings water and wind resistance without losing flexibility, while an elasticated waistband with internal drawcords and six belt loops keep it comfortable. Four zipped welt pockets and two concealed pockets keep essentials secure, and the straight leg holds a clean, refined line through your swing.

products.title: GOAT Pique Polo Solid
products.body_html: The GOAT Pique Polo 2.0 is an updated version that blends performance with a vintage aesthetic. Using a cotton blend pique fabric with drirelease® technology, it accelerates the water release rate, pushing perspiration to the outside of the garment where it evaporates faster than other performance fabrics. The anti-shrink fabric maintains a vintage dry cotton hand feel. With ribbed collar and sleeves, a traditional placket, and a relaxed fit, this polo delivers timeless style with modern performance.

products.title: Blade Putter Cover
products.body_html: A blade putter cover cut from durable PU leather, with dancing emblem embroidery across the exterior. Soft fleece lining inside helps shield the putter from scuffs, while the traditional shape keeps the fit snug on top. Built for the bag, the boot, and every practice session in between.

products.title: Barrel Driver Cover
products.body_html: A driver cover cut from durable PU leather, with the dancing emblem embroidery worked across the exterior. Soft fleece lining inside protects the clubhead without adding bulk, while the traditional barrel shape slips on easily and stays secure through every round.

products.title: Barrel Wood Cover
products.body_html: A fairway wood cover cut from durable PU leather, shaped in the same traditional barrel profile. Finished with dancing emblem embroidery at the exterior and soft-lined with fleece to cradle the clubhead without extra bulk.

products.title: Mesh Cap
products.body_html: The Mesh Cap takes a few cues from running, cycling and the sort of outdoor wear that gets properly tested by the British elements. Lightweight nylon stretch fabric, mesh side panels, and enough structure to belong on the fairways.

products.title: Gentleman Jack® x MANORS Blade Polo
products.body_html: The Gentleman Jack x MANORS Blade Polo carries the Drip pattern, pulled from a rich Jack Daniels archive of a whiskey drip and printed across the body. The flow of the print echoes the flow you spend the round chasing. A sharp blade collar and snap-button placket sit on top of soft Seawool® fabric, made from recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles. UV 50+ protection, moisture management, and natural odour control through the back nine. 4-way stretch for free movement, light on the skin. Part of the Gentleman Jack x MANORS capsule.

products.title: Gentleman Jack® x MANORS Driver Cover
products.body_html: A driver cover cut from pebbled PU leather, with the Tennessee artwork embroidered at the centre. Soft lined inside to protect the head, snug fit on top. Built to live in the bag for the long haul. Part of the Gentleman Jack x MANORS capsule.

products.title: Gentleman Jack® x MANORS Retro Crown Cap
products.body_html: A six-panel snap back with a short crown that sits low on the head for a sharp look, finished with a pre-curved brim that holds its shape round after round. The Gentleman Jack x MANORS Retro Crown Cap carries a silicon patch Tennessee artwork applied to the centre front. One size fits all, adjustable at the back. Inspired by a baseball classic, dressed for the course. Part of the Gentleman Jack x MANORS capsule.

products.title: Gentleman Jack® x MANORS Paisley Towel
Gentleman Jack® x MANORS Scorecard Holder
products.body_html: Cut from PU leather with the Tennessee artwork embroidered at the centre. Part of the Gentleman Jack x MANORS capsule.

products.title: Gentleman Jack® x MANORS Paisley Polo
products.body_html: The Gentleman Jack x MANORS Paisley Polo carries a paisley print drawn from the engraved detailing on vintage Gentleman Jack bottles. A clean polo silhouette with curved side panelling, a ribbed collar, three tonal branded buttons, and heat transfer print branding at the chest and back. Soft Seawool® fabric, made from recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles, brings UV 50+ protection, moisture management, and natural odour control through long summer rounds. 150gsm with 4-way stretch, fresh enough between wears that you'll wash it less. Part of the Gentleman Jack x MANORS capsule.

products.title: Gentleman Jack® x MANORS Logo T-Shirt
products.body_html: The Gentleman Jack x MANORS Logo T-Shirt carries a digitally printed Tennessee artwork at the centre of the chest. Cut from premium 240gsm cotton with a relaxed fit, soft on the skin and built to wear in over time. Easy to layer under a knit on cool mornings or solo through the warm-up. The kind of tee that lives in rotation, on the course or off it. Part of the Gentleman Jack x MANORS capsule.

products.title: Gentleman Jack® x MANORS Merino Crewneck
products.body_html: The Gentleman Jack x MANORS Merino Crewneck carries a jacquard Tennessee artwork knitted into the centre of the chest. Built from 100% natural merino wool, the game's original performance fabric. Warm when the wind bites, cool when the sun breaks through, and it won't hold odour after a long day on the course. Soft on the skin, machine-washable, won't shrink or lose shape. The 9-Gauge knit gives it a heavier, vintage feel. Part of the Gentleman Jack x MANORS capsule.

products.title: The MANORS Summer Invitational
products.body_html:
MANORS SUMMER INVITATIONAL

Stoke Park - 2nd June | 9AM–6PM

Join us for a full day of golf, hospitality, and competition at the iconic Stoke Park for the MANORS Summer Invitational.

Whether entering solo or as a fourball, expect a premium golf experience brought together by MANORS, with good people, great golf, and a day built around exploring the game.

All guests will receive a limited edition MANORS polo as a gift on arrival (£85 RRP Value)

Ticket Information

£180 per person

Your Ticket Includes:
- Breakfast on arrival
- 18 holes at Stoke Park
- Drinks served throughout the course (limited allocation per guest)
- Post-round BBQ
- Invitational goody bag
- Competitions & prizes throughout the day

A limited number of places are available. Please email minnie@manorsgolf.com if you want to be paired up with other ticket holders. This will be a team event.

products.title: Ranger Golf Short
products.body_html: The Ranger Golf Short brings a '90s athletic attitude to the fairways when the temperature climbs. Lightweight, water resistant, wind resistant and built for movement, it pairs an elasticated waistband with an internal drawcord for a clean, dialled-in fit, while YKK zipped hand pockets and back welt pockets keep your essentials secure. Heat transfer 'Manors' branding to the back leg keeps things sharp. Warm up, play through, built to move.

products.title: Stableford Short
products.body_html: Made from a Primeflex™ recycled polyester blend, the Stableford Short delivers the crisp, structured feel of cotton twill with mechanical two-way stretch and a crease-resistant finish (no wrinkles ever) that holds its shape from the first tee to sundown drinks. Front hand pockets and back patch pockets — all with YKK zips — handle storage, while an elasticated waistband, belt loops and an internal drawcord dial in the fit anywhere from a public track to a country club. A new silhouette for golf, stripped back for summer.

products.title: Buttersoft Polo
products.body_html: Some polos look the part. The Buttersoft Polo feels it. A classic silhouette built from a Drirelease® cotton/poly blend, this is the softest polo we've ever made; light, smooth and naturally comfortable from the first wear. The unique Drirelease® technology combines synthetic and natural fibres to push moisture through and out of the garment faster than other performance fabrics on the market, keeping you cool and dry for back to back rounds and then the clubhouse. Yarn-dyed stripes with a vintage, sun-faded look, ribbed collar and sleeves, raglan construction for natural movement, and tonal branded buttons finish a polo built to be your everyday favourite

products.title: MANORS x Original Jones Bag - Espresso
products.body_html: The name says it all: Original Jones. This is the golf bag that started it all in 1971 and has become one of the most iconic bags in the game. Combining traditional George Jones stylings with modern materials the Original is designed specifically for the walking golfer. Water-resistant nylon keeps grips dry for those dew-sweepers and all-weather players. The retro single strap and unstructured body pay homage to keeping golf simple while three pockets provide plenty of room for your playing necessities. Make your walk more enjoyable by carrying the Jones Original

products.title: Recycled Greenskeeper Jacket
products.body_html: The Recycled Greenskeeper Jacket takes inspiration from vintage workwear pullovers through its silhouette, pocketing, and trim details. Designed to pair with our ever popular Recycled Greenskeeper Trousers, it brings the same rugged functionality to the fairway. Built with 4-way stretch fabric at 178gsm and a back gusset with internal mesh panel, it delivers extra mobility around the shoulder blades for unrestricted movement through your swing. Three patch pockets keep essentials within reach, while adjustable snap cuffs and a dropped shoulder create a relaxed, workwear inspired fit.

products.title: GOAT Pique Polo Monogram
products.body_html: The GOAT Pique Polo Monogram is an updated version that blends performance with a vintage aesthetic. Using a cotton blend pique fabric with drirelease® technology, it accelerates the water release rate, pushing perspiration to the outside of the garment where it evaporates faster than other performance fabrics. The anti-shrink fabric maintains a vintage dry cotton hand feel, while the Monogram Eighteenth Repeater pattern lets you stand out on the fairway. With ribbed collar and sleeves, a traditional placket, and a relaxed fit, this polo delivers timeless style with modern moisture management

products.title: Highland Packable Pullover
products.body_html: The Highland Packable Pullover is the ultimate insurance policy for unpredictable weather on the course. Lightweight, water resistant, and built with 4-way stretch, it packs into its own pocket so you can stash it in any golf bag without taking up space. When conditions shift, the mock neck collar provides extra coverage, while concealed snaps and elasticated cuffs lock in warmth. Two welt pockets keep essentials secure and dry. At just 91gsm, it's barely there until you need it, delivering protection without bulk or weight.

products.title: Organic Course Pullover 2.0
products.body_html: The Organic Course Pullover 2.0 combines comfort, warmth, and sustainability in one versatile layer. Made from 100% GOTS-certified organic cotton at 330gsm, it's built for layering on and off the green. The relaxed fit provides room for easy movement, while raglan sleeves and ribbed details at the collar, hem, and sleeves add timeless style. With embroidered branding and a soft cotton jersey hand feel, this pullover is as versatile off the course as it is on it.

products.title: Organic Logo Hoodie 2.0
products.body_html: Stay cosy and stylish in the Organic Logo Hoodie, crafted from GOTS-certified organic cotton. Its brushed fleece interior provides warmth, while the kangaroo pocket and relaxed fit ensure comfort on casual days. Whether you’re cooling down after a round or relaxing off the course, this hoodie has you covered.

products.title: Pebble Course Polo
products.body_html: The Pebble Course Polo builds on our year-round essential with an all-over print inspired by on-course shapes and technical outdoor sport. Crafted from soft Seawool®—made using recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles—it delivers UV 50+ protection, moisture management and odour control. Lightweight stretch fabric ensures unrestricted movement, bringing a bold, performance-led edge to a classic silhouette

products.title: Lightweight Course Gilet
products.body_html: The Lightweight Course Gilet is built for golfers who need packable performance. Inspired by durable outdoor hiking gear, it combines 4-way stretch with water resistant protection in a minimal, lightweight design. Three concealed pockets keep essentials secure, while a two-way zipper enhances mobility through your swing. The curved contrast side panels add contemporary style, and at just 91gsm, it packs easily into any golf bag without adding bulk. The regular fit layers comfortably over polos or base layers, making it the ideal spring transition piece when conditions shift on the course.

products.title: Club Pant
products.body_html: Bridging technical performance with refined style, the Club Pant is at home in a michelin star restaurant as it is on the golf course. Made from a 4-way stretch nylon spandex blend at 148gsm, it offers water and wind resistance without sacrificing flexibility. The elasticated waistband with internal drawcords maximises comfort, while six belt loops accompany you for days at the country club. Four welt pockets with internal zips and two concealed pockets keep essentials secure. The straight leg design ensures easy movement through your swing while maintaining a clean, refined silhouette. A staple for any golfer's wardrobe

products.title: Tour Shirt
products.body_html: The Tour Shirt is a wind and water resistant short sleeve layer inspired by vintage wind proofs. It's ideal for layering over a polo or long sleeve when conditions shift. At 148gsm, the lightweight 4-way stretch fabric combines freedom of movement with protection against the elements. Curved front and back panelling with raglan sleeves provide a comfortable, relaxed fit, while concealed pockets keep essentials safe and dry. A bonded YKK centre front zip and adjustable hem with cord and toggle ensure versatility when the temperature swings as much as you do.

products.title: Club Polo
products.body_html: The Club Polo draws inspiration from vintage European football shirts of the late 90s, bringing ribbed collar details and raglan sleeves into a modern golf context. Bold mesh panelling under the arms and at the back neck adds breathability where you need it most, while side hem vents ensure airflow during long rounds. Made from soft Seawool® fabric, crafted from recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles, it delivers UV 50+ protection, moisture management, and odour control. The relaxed fit and 4-way stretch allow unrestricted movement, making it perfect for golfers who want a fresh take on classic sportswear style.

products.title: Outsider Polartec® Polo
products.body_html: The Outsider Polartec® Polo is built for high temperatures and long rounds when staying cool matters most. Using Polartec® Power Dry, a bi-component knit that creates superior wicking and breathability, this polo pulls moisture away from the skin and spreads it across the fabric for rapid evaporation. At just 112gsm, it's exceptionally lightweight and fast drying. Flatlock stitching removes irritation, while the grown-on hidden snap placket keeps the look minimal and clean. The regular fit and 4-way stretch ensure unrestricted movement when the heat is on.

products.title: Lightweight Pleated Short
products.body_html: Lightweight and versatile, the Lightweight Pleated Shorts bring the same Primeflex™ performance as their trouser counterpart, offering exceptional durability, 4 way stretch, and comfort. Water-resistant and soft to the touch, they create a crisp base for both smart and informal combinations. Thoughtful details like double pleats and a ticket pocket for scorecards ensure timeless style meets modern golf functionality—perfect for hot summer rounds or off-course wear.

products.title: Course Cap
products.body_html: The go to golf cap with moisture wicking sweatband, structured lightweight construction, and classic fit. Features velcro strap back and embroidered logos.

products.title: Pebble Tech Cap
products.body_html: Inspired by on course shapes and technical outdoor sports. A one size fits all cap made from technical fabrics for performance on the fairways. The most stylish and functional golf hat we've ever made

products.title: Club 6 Panel Cap
products.body_html: Low profile lightweight nylon cap with moisture wicking sweatband and structured construction. Features adjustable snap back and embroidered logos.

products.title: Knitted Baker Boy Cap
products.body_html: Samuel L and Jordan inspired cap styled to be worn backwards. Lightweight knitted polyester fabric with an open weave to keep you cool. Features embroidered logo.

products.title: Lightweight Course Jacket
products.body_html: The Lightweight Course Jacket is a versatile layer designed for movement, offering lightweight protection against cold, wind, and rain. Built with 4-way stretch nylon spandex at 125gsm, it moves with your swing without restriction. Internal microfleece lining at the collar and pockets adds warmth where you need it. Three concealed pockets keep essentials secure and dry. The two-way zipper enhances mobility and allows you to adjust ventilation on the move. This jacket is built to perform through unpredictable spring conditions without weighing you down.

products.title: Mockneck Course Polo
products.body_html: The Mockneck Course Polo pays homage to a collar style that has been on golf's biggest stages for decades. Jack Nicklaus wore a turtleneck under a sweater when he lifted the Claret Jug in 1962, Tony Jacklin had a purple mock in 1969, and Gary Player, who consistently wore the style, had it on when holding the trophy in 1968. The high neck has been a part of the game since the beginning, and this version made from soft Seawool® fabric, crafted from recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles, delivers UV 50+ protection, moisture management, and odour control to bring you into the modern era.

products.title: Reversible V-Neck Vest
products.body_html: The Reversible V-Neck Vest draws inspiration from sportswear garments of the 90s and 2000s, when reversibility was all the rage. Featuring a heritage check print on one side and a plain coloured reverse, it acknowledges tradition without being bound by it. Built with a traditional v-neck silhouette but updated with water resistant, lightweight, 4-way stretch nylon fabric at 125gsm, it's designed for unpredictable conditions. Ribbed collar, hem, and sleeves provide a secure fit, while a tear-away care label removes irritation. The regular fit ensures easy layering across a wide temperature range

products.title: 1/4 Zip Tech Vest
products.body_html: The Quarter Zip Tech Vest is the ultimate layering piece for cool Spring and Summer days when it’s not quite warm enough for your Summer Polo fit. Lightweight, 4-way stretch, and moisture-wicking, it’s also great to throw in the bag for cool twilight rounds or early mornings. The sophisticated design and binding on the hem and sleeves adds minimalist style to your game.

products.title: GOAT Pique Polo
products.body_html: The GOAT Pique Polo 2.0 is an updated version that blends performance with a vintage aesthetic. Using a cotton blend pique fabric with drirelease® technology, it accelerates the water release rate, pushing perspiration to the outside of the garment where it evaporates faster than other performance fabrics. The anti-shrink fabric maintains a vintage dry cotton hand feel, while yarn-dyed stripes ensure your only fade is off the tee. With ribbed collar and sleeves, a traditional placket, and a relaxed fit, this polo delivers timeless style with modern performance.

products.title: Stableford Trousers
products.body_html: The Stableford Trouser blends combines classic workwear with a nod to golf’s golden era to bring an entirely new silhouette to the fairways. The Primeflex™ recycled fabric blend fabric of the Stableford Trouser, mimics the crisp, tightly woven feel of cotton twill but delivers lightweight stretch, durability, and wrinkle resistance to keep you looking and feeling sharp through every swing. Its high-waisted, straight-leg fit and turned-up hems evokes images of Ben Hogan, while zipped side and back workwear-style pockets plus an internal elastic waistband add practical function. This is a rethink on what golf trousers can and should deliver on and off the course.

products.title: Tailored Frontier Polo
products.body_html: Didn’t anyone ever tell you to play smart golf? The Frontier Tailored Shirt with its 4-way stretch lightweight and water-resistant fabric is designed to handle sudden shifts in weather while offering a crisp, professional look. The chest pocket adds storage, and the concealed placket enhances its sleek design. Whether worn over a base layer or on its own, this top ensures you play smart golf and transitions effortlessly from the course to the clubhouse.

products.title: Outsider Polartec® Hoodie
products.body_html: The Outsider Polartec® Hoodie is a lightweight, wicking layer built for spring golf and multi-activity use. Using Polartec® Power Dry, a bi-component knit that creates superior wicking and breathability, it pulls moisture away from the skin and spreads it across the fabric for rapid evaporation. At just 112gsm, it's exceptionally lightweight and fast drying. Flatlock stitching removes irritation, while a sleek tight-fitting hood provides coverage without bulk. Elastic binding on sleeves, hem, and hood ensure a secure fit. The regular fit and 4-way stretch allow unrestricted movement in hot or cold conditions

products.title: MANORS Matches
products.body_html: Light the candle in style this winter with the MANORS matches. A dozen matches encased in classic MANORS branding adds the golfing nod to your coffee table set up.

products.title: Repurposed Utility Bag
products.body_html: Made from otherwise wasted materials, the repurposed utility bag is the perfect store for all your golf essentials.

products.title: Greenskeeper Barrel Headcover
products.body_html: The Greenskeeper Barrel Headcover is made from repurposed fabric from our own collections to avoid waste, it features a water-resistant exterior to shield your driver from rain and scuffs, while the gridded fleece interior cradles the clubhead softly without adding bulk. Emblazoned with the Eighteen Anywhere MANORS logo, it's a nod to golfing freedom that slips on easily and stays secure through every round or travel day.

products.title: MANORS x JONES BLACK BOMBER CARRY BAG
products.body_html: The MANORS x Jones Special Edition black bomber carry bag is the first ever golf bag by Manors Golf Apparel with extremely limited availability. The classic unstructured body and single strap maintains the traditional Jones design ensuring you can carry your bag anywhere, while the sleek black design and MANORS embroidery lets people know the type of golfer you are. The leather-look vinyl allows for easy cleaning and won’t soak up the morning dew.

products.title: 2.5L Pertex® Waterproof Bottom
products.body_html: The 2.5L Waterproof Bottom has been designed to be worn over a pair of trousers. The trouser is constructed from Pertex ® Shield Pro, ideal for intense pursuits in challenged conditions, where waterproofness, breathability, and durability are the priority

products.title: 2.5L Pertex® Waterproof Jacket
products.body_html: The 2.5L Waterproof Jacket can be packed in its own pocket and has a waterproof and windproof membrane. The jacket is constructed from Pertex ® Shield Pro, ideal for intense pursuits in challenged conditions, where waterproofness, breathability, and durability are the priority.

products.title: 2.5L Pertex® Waterproof Tech Cap
products.body_html: The 2.5L Waterproof Tech Cap is is constructed from Pertex Shield Pro, idieal for intense pursuits in challenged conditions, where waterproofness, breathability, and durability are the priority

products.title: Recycled Greenskeeper Bucket Hat
products.body_html: Using our Recycled Greenskeeper Jacket and trouser fabric, this bucket hat features a wide brim to complete the look.

products.title: Ranger Beanie
products.body_html: The Ranger Beanie will take you from the range to faraway winter rounds and everywhere in between.

products.title: Highland Mockneck Fleece
products.body_html: The Highland Mockneck Fleece is the ultimate cool-weather versatility piece, warm enough to wear on its own and light enough to layer. The gridded fleece construction traps heat without adding bulk, while underarm panels use a reversed fabric to enhance airflow where you need it most. A ribbed mockneck collar keeps the wind off your neck, and statement back branding ensures it looks as good off the course as on. Designed for autumn and winter rounds where the balance between movement and warmth are key.

products.title: Heritage Check Ranger Jacket
products.body_html: If we ever got to outfit Scotland’s national golf team, this is what they’d wear. The Heritage Check Golf Jacket reimagines the bold, athletic tracksuits of ‘90s Olympic teams and Serie A squads, crafted for the fairways with a warped tartan print that celebrates Bonnie Scotland’s golfing legacy. Made from crinkled nylon, this water-resistant, ¼-zip jacket offers stretch for fluid swings in all conditions. Raglan sleeves, retro contrast piping, and striking branding bring team-ready confidence, while a breathable mesh lining and concealed storage pockets add course-ready function. With its proud tartan design, this jacket is your uniform for carving shots and dominating on the links.

products.title: Heritage Check Ranger Pant
products.body_html: If we ever outfit Scotland’s national golf team, this is what they will wear. The Heritage Check Golf Jacket reimagines the bold, athletic tracksuits of ‘90s Olympic teams and Serie A squads, crafted for the fairways with a warped tartan print that celebrates Bonnie Scotland’s golfing legacy. Made from crinkled nylon, this water-resistant, ¼-zip jacket offers stretch for fluid swings in all conditions. The striking print brings team-ready confidence, while a breathable mesh lining and concealed storage pockets add course-ready function. With its proud tartan design, these pants are your uniform for carving shots and dominating on the links.

products.title: Merino Tech Vest
products.body_html: The Merino Tech Vest is made from the finest 100% natural merino wool, the original performance fabric. Like it did for sheep on the original Scottish linksland, merino will keep you warm when it’s cold and cool when it’s hot. But unlike their old-school knits, this one is treated so you can throw it in the wash and not worry about shrinking or losing shape. The 9 Gauge knit has a heavier, vintage feel that complements the V neck style and makes an excellent piece for off course occasions. We’ve also reinforced the garment with laser-cut ripstop panels, so if it gets beat up in your bag and you throw it on before entering the clubhouse you’ll still come out looking sharp. The backwards facing side pocket is in the shape of a golf green, because why not?

products.title: Merino Tech Crewneck
products.body_html: The Merino Tech Crewneck is built from 100% natural merino wool, the game’s original performance fabric. It keeps you warm when the wind bites, cool when the sun breaks through, and it won’t hold odour even after a long day on the course. Unlike the scratchy wool jumpers of the past, this one is soft, machine-washable, and won’t shrink or lose shape. The 9-Gauge knit gives it a heavier, vintage feel, while laser-cut ripstop panels and elbow patches nod to golf’s history and add durability where you need it. Smart enough for the clubhouse, tough enough to live in your bag.

products.title: Merino Tech Windbreaker
products.body_html: The Merino Tech Windbreaker combines the extraordinary natural performance of merino knitwear with a technical lining for elite warmth and protection. Crafted from 100% natural merino wool, it regulates temperature, resists odour, and stays soft round after round. We’ve treated it so you can throw it in the wash without worrying about shrinking, and the 9-Gauge knit gives it a vintage, slightly weightier feel. Inside, a windproof lining takes the edge off blustery days, so you can keep swinging when others head for shelter. It’s golf knitwear taken to a whole new status of functionality: warm, breathable, and enhanced with modern technology to handle whatever the elements throw at you.

products.title: Crosswind Cordura® V-Neck
products.body_html: Crafted with high-tenacity Cordura® nylon ripstop fabric, originally developed for military use, the Crosswind Cordura® V-neck offers unmatched resistance to tears, abrasions, and scuffs, while its 4-way stretch ensures a free, fluid swing. A PFC-free water-repellent finish sheds light rain, and wind-resistant properties keep you warm against chilly gusts. With side vent zips for mobility, concealed storage pockets with internal compartments for secure essentials, and a breathable mesh lining for airflow, this piece delivers rugged reliability and comfort for any course or condition. You will also look very good in a warm pub.

products.title: Arc Polo
products.body_html: The Arc Polo blends classic and modern design. A twin-tipped collar and relaxed fit nod to heritage, while performance-driven details such as our Seawool® fabric, snap closures, contrast panelling, and bold back branding offer a modern edge.

products.title: Insulated Course Jacket
products.body_html: The Insulated Course Jacket is the long sleeve style of our best selling gilet. Featuring comfortemp® thermal insulation, it retains heat without weighing you down. Additional features include a fleece lined collar, three pockets for storage, and contrasting sleeve and body fabric for an increased range of movement.

products.title: Eighteenth Ranger Polo
products.body_html: The brushed back fabric of the Eighteenth Ranger Polo ensures temperature control for cooler months. Donned with the MANORS emblem repeater pattern the polo features a 4 way stretching upper back panel to support your swing, a chest pocket, a modern quarter zip and ribbed sleeves and cuffs that maintain the classic polo structure

products.title: Heritage Check Polo
products.body_html: Our popular Course Polo meets a modern rendition of Scotland's most recognisable export: so you can acknowledge tradition without being bound by it. The Course polo combines sustainability and performance with a classic silhouette. Made from our soft Seawool® fabric - crafted from recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles - it offers UV 50+ protection, moisture management, and odour control. With lightweight stretch material this polo is designed to keep you swinging freely all year round

products.title: Eighteenth Ranger Towel
products.body_html: The Eighteenth Towel for 18 anywhere.

products.title: Course Visor
products.body_html: Too hot for a hat but desperately in need of a some shade across the face? Or perhaps you understand the cultural significance of having a hole in the top of your hat? Either way - the Visor is back on the fairways and we at MANORS are here for it

products.title: Recycled Greenskeeper Shorts
products.body_html: Technical shorts with worker-like pockets made fit for the golf course with classic double pleats and innovative water and wind resistant recycled performances fabrics.

products.title: 1/4 Zip Lightweight Mid-Layer
products.body_html: For days when it’s too cold for short sleeves and too hot for a proper jumper. The fabric yarn has been made with conductive fibres that respond to body temperature, engineered to keep you cool when it’s hot and warm when it’s cold. The fabric has a soft silk feel that’s perfect for layering during early morning tee times or breezy summer evenings. The minimalistic design and comfort makes it an essential golf garment.

products.title: Lightweight Performance Polo
products.body_html: Stay cool under pressure with the Lightweight Performance Polo. Made from conductive fabric fibres that respond to body temperature, it's perfect for summer rounds. The silky soft breathable fabric has also been treated to keep odours at bay, while a reinforced collar stops any unwanted flapping and raglan sleeves enhance movement. A polo that works as hard as you do.

products.title: Manors Logo T-Shirt
products.body_html: Stay comfortable and effortlessly stylish in the MANORS Logo T-Shirt. Crafted from premium 240gsm cotton, this relaxed-fit essential offers a soft yet durable feel, perfect for everyday wear.

products.title: Lightweight Pleated Trouser
products.body_html: Classic chinos meet performance golfwear in the Chino Greenskeeper Trouser, crafted from Primeflex™ fabric for exceptional durability, stretch, and lightweight comfort. Water-resistant and soft to the touch, these trousers create a crisp base if you want to dress smart or add a more informal combination. Thoughtful details like double pleats and a ticket pocket for scorecards seamlessly combine timeless style with modern functionality removing the limitations on what a golf chino can be.

products.title: Lightweight Course Trousers
products.body_html: Built for summer golf, the updated Lightweight Course Trouser 2.0 are made to move with 4-way stretch lightweight and water-resistant fabric to keep you cool and moving freely. The internal elastic waistband and functional zip pockets ensure practicality and easy access to essentials.

products.title: Shooter Shirt
products.body_html: Inspired by the effortless style of late-90s basketball, the updated Shooter Shirt 2.0 is designed for when the temperature swings as much as you do. Its water and wind-resistant fabric offers protection in unpredictable weather, while the relaxed fit, mesh lining, and four-way stretch fabric ensure comfort and breathability. Featuring bold back branding and functional details like chest pockets and hem toggles, it’s the perfect statement piece for the modern golfer across the seasons.

products.title: Blade Course Polo
products.body_html: The Blade Course Polo brings bold design and sharp focus to your game. The Flow Finder graphic print is inspired by “the zone” all golfers are trying to reach. This polo uses our soft Seawool® fabric—crafted from recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles–for breathability, odour control, and UV 50+ protection. Its blade collar and snap-button placket deliver a contemporary edge, while the lightweight, 4-way stretch material moves with you through every swing.

products.title: Long Sleeve Course Polo
products.body_html: The Long Sleeve Course Polo is designed for cooler rounds, offering a perfect balance of comfort and performance. Made from our soft feel Seawool® fabric—crafted from recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles—the Long Sleeve Course Polo offers UV 50+ protection, moisture management, and odour control. The breathable fabric and regular fit make it an ideal layering piece, keeping you warm without restricting mobility. Perfect for those mornings that start chilly and warm up as the day goes on.

products.title: Course Polo
products.body_html: The updated Course Polo 2.0 is a year-round essential, combining sustainability and performance with a classic silhouette. Made from our soft Seawool® fabric—crafted from recycled oyster shells and plastic bottles—the Course Polo offers UV 50+ protection, moisture management, and odour control. With lightweight stretch material this polo is designed to keep you swinging freely all year round.

products.title: Insulated Course Gilet
products.body_html: The updated Insulated Course Gilet 2.0 is built for lightweight warmth and unrestricted movement. Featuring comfortemp® thermal insulation, it retains heat without weighing you down. 4-way stretch fabric enhances movement, while fleece-lined zip pockets, collar, and a quilted interior add functionality, insulation, and style. Ideal for layering, this gilet is perfect for crisp winter mornings or breezy afternoons.

products.title: MGA T-Shirt
products.body_html: Stay comfortable and effortlessly stylish in the MANORS Logo T-Shirt. Crafted from premium 240gsm cotton, this relaxed-fit essential offers a soft yet durable feel, perfect for everyday wear.

products.title: Recycled Greenskeeper Trouser
products.body_html: The 4-way stretch, water- and wind-resistant Recycled Greenskeeper Trouser, made from 93% recycled nylon and 7% Spandex, brings the classic worker style to the course. The Trousers feature a fully elasticated waistband with a drawcord, 8 storage pockets, and relaxed fit. The double-pleat at the front nods to timeless on-course etiquette, so you can combine a sharp look with rugged functionality, making them perfect for long summer rounds or casual off-course wear.

products.title: Tour Polo
products.body_html: The Tour Polo draws inspiration from beyond the fairway, channeling the mental toughness of one of the world’s most demanding sports. Combining cycling-inspired aesthetics with performance-driven design, the Tour Polo is constructed from our soft Seawool® fabric, offering moisture-wicking, odour control, and UV 50+ protection. The 1/4 placket and statement back branding add modern, standout style. For bold players who go the distance.

products.title: Gailes Windbreaker
products.body_html: The updated Gailes Windbreaker is made to tackle the gales of the world’s coastal courses with style and substance. Constructed from 4-way stretch, wind-repellent, and water-repellent fabric, it keeps you protected without sacrificing comfort or style. The relaxed fit, adjustable hem, and mesh lining ensure optimal performance and versatility, while its generous concealed pockets are perfect for stashing extra golf balls—you’ll need them where you’re going.

products.title: Ranger Golf Jacket
products.body_html: These days, golfers are athletes, so why is our sport the only one without an iconic competitive tracksuit to warm up and play in? Not anymore. The Ranger Golf Jacket is a re-imagined sportswear classic made fit for the fairways with raglan sleeves and woven nylon fabric to maximise movement.

products.title: MANORS Chino Cap
products.body_html: This timeless style of the MANORS Chino Cap is an essential staple for any golf wardrobe. Made with a durable six panel construction and premium 100% Cotton Twill for soft breathable comfort on and off the course. One size fits all with the adjustable strap.

products.title: 1/4 Zip Tech Mid-Layer
products.body_html: A technical quarter zip mid-layer featuring curved panelling that articulates to support the body’s movement. Precise seam placements create an upper back panel that curves around the arms, improving athletic performance and reducing irritation. The 3 piece sleeve ergonomically curves around the elbow to support your swing. And 3 concealed zip pockets create a smart storage system. Our most precise garment ever

products.title: Eighteenth Crew Sock
products.body_html: Why is it so hard to find a great sock these days? Tired of waiting, MANORS developed our own crew sock with a perfect cotton spandex blend to ensure comfort and flexibility. An enhanced arch support and a terry cushion bottom will take you through 18 holes and beyond in style and comfort.

products.title: Retro Crown Cap
products.body_html: Inspired by a baseball classic, the Retro Crown Cap is a one size fits all, adjustable snap back that sits low on the head for a sharp look.

products.body_html: Feeling Generous? The gift card that all golfers want...

products.body_html: 20 MANORS tees per box, 70mm, Plastic free, Hard wearing
